precedence_mapping.empty: Use the empty plot state; no notification marker

semantics: Help/question is help, never unseen content.
Construction is only for truthful active build states.
New, gift, heart, complete and retry are supplemental states/actions, not overrides of town marker precedence.
Animations are implementation suggestions only; files are static PNGs. Never bake flashing into art.

assets.name: unseen
assets.prompt:
Create ONE game interface marker as a standalone transparent square PNG, about 1024 by 1024. Bold simple silhouette clearly readable at 32 pixels. The object fills 60-70 percent of the canvas width and height, centred with generous transparent margins. True transparent alpha background, no checkerboard, no coloured backdrop. Flat gouache and folk woodblock shapes on handmade paper, subtle paper grain, restrained imperfect cut edges, shallow paper layering. Match reference board palette and paper material only, never its layout. Indigo, muted jade, terracotta, cream and restrained ochre. Soft even daylight, no glossy 3D, no vector look. No spreading cast shadow. No border or watermark. No writing except the explicitly requested punctuation/check/arrow symbol. No added decorations or extra objects.
